title: Finance Ministry to raise EPF wage ceiling to ₹25,000/month
summary: Ceiling rise: ₹15,000 → ₹25,000/month, pending Cabinet approval; implementation anticipated **1 April 2027**...

items: Ceiling rise: ₹15,000 → ₹25,000/month, pending Cabinet approval; implementation anticipated **1 April 2027**
Related: EPF account turns inoperative 3 yrs after retirement/migration/death; member retiring before 55 earns interest till 58; EPF number = 22-digit, UAN = permanent 12-digit

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → EPF wage ceiling change (₹15,000→₹25,000); don't confuse EPF# (22-digit) with UAN (12-digit).
